channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Valdemar pede unidade, elogia Michelle e quer reconciliá-la com Flávio
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL party, called for internal party unity and advocated for reconciliation between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro, the senator’s stepmother, to strengthen Flávio’s 2026 presidential bid. He praised Michelle as 'special' and said he would work to bring her closer to Flávio despite current estrangement following her accusations of humiliation and disrespect. Valdemar also referenced the ongoing appeal of Jair Bolsonaro’s conviction at the STF, stating that 'many surprises' could unfold in the next 20 to 30 days, potentially reshaping the electoral landscape.

item.title: Mauro Vieira terá de se explicar à Câmara sobre risco de ação militar dos EUA no Brasil
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira has been summoned by the Chamber of Deputies' Foreign Relations and National Defense Committee to explain his statements regarding the risk of U.S. military action in Brazil, linked to the U.S. designation of the Comando Vermelho and PCC as terrorist organizations. The summons, initiated by Deputy Evair Vieira de Melo, is mandatory, and Vieira must clarify his claim that the designation could be invoked to justify extraterritorial military force against Brazil. No date has yet been set for the hearing.

item.title: Alcolumbre reclama com o governo de fala do líder do PT na Câmara e amplia impasse com o Planalto
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre complained to government leader Teresa Leitão after PT Chamber leader Pedro Uczai stated he would be labeled an "enemy of workers" if he does not advance the PEC ending the 6x1 workweek. Alcolumbre rejected the remarks as threats and intimidation, asserting that Senate agenda-setting is his constitutional prerogative and not subject to political pressure. The rift, worsened by the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination—led by Alcolumbre—remains unresolved despite a PT-proposed truce until next week, with no scheduled meeting with President Lula.

item.title: Flávio adia definição de candidato ao Senado no RJ por temor ao STF
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) postponed the decision on the PL's Senate candidate in Rio de Janeiro due to fear of STF intervention, particularly from Ministers Flávio Dino and Alexandre de Moraes, who have authorized operations against his allies. He favors Carlos Jordy, under investigation for irregular use of parliamentary funds, but also considers Sóstenes Cavalcante and Carlos Portinho after an operation nullified Márcio Canella’s pre-candidacy.

item.title: Participe da votação do Bola na Copa e eleja o gol mais bonito das oitavas de final da Copa
item.description: The Bola na Copa voting is now open to choose the most beautiful goal from the round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup. Three contenders are in the running: Erling Haaland’s second goal against Brazil, Julián Quiñones’ stunning strike for Mexico against England, and Lionel Messi’s goal in Argentina’s comeback win over Egypt. Fans can participate in the poll to elect the winner.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 55% e aprovado por 42% em SP, diz Datafolha
item.description: Lula has a 42% approval rating and 55% disapproval in São Paulo, according to a Datafolha poll from July 2026. The evaluation of his government is rated as excellent or good by 29%, regular by 26%, and bad or terrible by 43%. The survey interviewed 1,608 voters with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Crusoé: Pesquisa mostra empate técnico entre Lula e Flávio em SP
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on April 8 shows President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) tied at 35% in voter intentions for the 2026 presidential election’s first round among São Paulo voters. In a potential runoff, the two remain in a technical tie within the margin of error, though Flávio Bolsonaro holds a slight numerical lead of 46% to Lula’s 44%, per the excerpt. The race reflects national polarization in Brazil’s largest electoral college.

item.title: Flávio tem 46% e Lula, 43% no 2º turno em SP, diz Datafolha
item.description: In a simulated 2026 presidential runoff in São Paulo, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 46% voter intention, narrowly ahead of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 43%, according to a Datafolha poll conducted from July 1–3. The 2-point margin of error indicates a technical tie. In the first-round simulation, both candidates are also tied at 35%. Another 10% would vote blank/null and 1% were undecided.

item.title: Após briga entre Flávio e Michelle, Valdemar diz que 'pessoal precisa se entender melhor’ para vencer eleição
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto called for unity and patience among conservative allies to win the 2026 elections, without directly mentioning the feud between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro but acknowledging the need for better internal understanding. He said the political landscape could shift due to STF rulings on Jair Bolsonaro’s defense appeals and reaffirmed that the former president chose Flávio as the best Senate candidate. The remarks were made at a Brasília lunch hosted by parliamentary fronts on competitiveness, entrepreneurship, technology, nuclear activities, and intellectual property.

item.title: Valdemar: “É preciso criar emprego e acabar com batalhão do Bolsa Família”
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated at a luncheon in Brasília that Brazil must attract companies to create jobs and end the 'battalion that exists in Bolsa Família'. He also advocated reducing the number of federal ministries, currently at 40, and emphasized Flávio Bolsonaro’s role in job creation. The event was organized by parliamentary fronts to discuss economic competitiveness proposals.

item.title: Valdemar ignora novelão entre Flávio e Michelle e defende mais mulheres na política
item.description: PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto ignored the family crisis between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro during a meeting with parliamentarians and business leaders, advocating for greater female participation in politics. He stated that more women in politics would be a better solution for the country, in an apparent effort to divert attention from the conflict between the presidential pre-candidate and the former first lady. The remarks come after Michelle released a nearly 30-minute video accusing Flávio of disrespect and mistreatment, raising concerns about his appeal among female voters.

item.title: Bolsonaristas abrem fogo amigo e criticam pré-campanha de Flávio
item.description: Bolsonaristas criticized the presidential pre-campaign of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) following his appearance at a U.S. hearing urging the country not to tax Brazilian products before the elections. The criticisms were posted on social media starting Tuesday, August 7, 2026, reflecting an internal 'friendly fire' within the Bolsonarist camp.

item.title: Sem mencionar pauta parada no Senado, Lula defende fim da 6 X 1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated in an Instagram post for ending the 6x1 work schedule, proposing a reduction of the workweek to 40 hours with two rest days, without affecting workers' pay. He stated the change would directly benefit 37 million Brazilians but did not mention that the corresponding PEC has been stalled in the Senate since May 28 due to tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The government aims to approve the proposal before the October 4 elections, though legislative recess and strained relations make this unlikely.

item.title: PF diz que não encontrou armas na casa de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police told Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that no weapons were found at Jair Bolsonaro’s residence during a search and seizure operation tied to his house arrest. The operation aimed to verify the handover of firearms registered under Bolsonaro’s name, following conflicting statements from his defense and the Army Battalion regarding two unaccounted weapons. The defense stated one pistol was seized by the Federal District Civil Police and a shotgun remains at a sporting goods store in Caxias do Sul, urging Moraes to formally request confirmation from the retailer.

item.title: Governo avalia adiar retirada dos subsídios dos combustíveis com retomada dos ataques no Irã
item.description: The Lula government is considering delaying the phased removal of fuel subsidies due to renewed attacks in Iran and oil market volatility, with crude prices above $80 a barrel. The move aims to avoid immediate pressure on fuel prices, particularly at Petrobras, while seeking 'understanding' from Congress and economic actors. The delay is also influenced by fiscal impacts and a pending congressional proposal to compensate for lost revenue from tax cuts on fuels.

item.title: Zé Trovão diz que Jair Bolsonaro foi covarde em 2022 e filhos do ex-presidente vão para o ataque
item.description: Federal deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC) called Jair Bolsonaro a 'coward' for not contesting the 2022 election result, sparking backlash from Bolsonaro's sons. Eduardo Bolsonaro, former deputy in the U.S., and Jair Renan, councilor in Balneário Camboriú, attacked Zé Trovão on social media, accusing him of opportunism and ingratitude despite running under Bolsonaro's PL party in 2022. The feud reflects growing internal tensions within Brazil's right-wing following the amnesty for those involved in the January 8 riots.

item.title: RENAN SANTOS na CORRIDA das ELEIÇÕES 2026.
item.description: Renan Santos is mentioned as a candidate in the 2026 elections, but the provided content contains no substantive information about his campaign, proposals, or performance. The text appears to be a fragment from a YouTube video with technical playback and sharing messages, lacking clear political relevance.

item.title: Vai à CCJ aumento de pena para crimes contra pessoa com deficiência
item.description: A bill increasing penalties for crimes against people with disabilities was approved in the Human Rights Committee and moves to the Constitution and Justice Committee. PL 4.598/2025 expands the penalty increase of two-thirds to double for bodily injury, regardless of where the aggression occurs, and adds disability as an aggravating factor in any crime. The specific rule for assaults in educational institutions by authorities is retained.

item.title: A popularidade de Lula em São Paulo a menos de 3 meses da eleição, segundo o Datafolha
item.description: According to a Datafolha poll released on July 8, 2026, 55% of São Paulo voters disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's performance, while 42% approve, indicating stability since March. Additionally, 63% of São Paulo voters believe Lula has done less for the state than expected, and only 29% rate his government as good or excellent.

item.title: Zema sobre evento do tarifaço nos EUA: Não fui convidado
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo Party's pre-candidate for president, stated he had no knowledge of the U.S. event concerning the 'tariff hike' where Senator Flávio Bolsonaro spoke. He denied being invited to the gathering.

item.title: Caiado critica discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro nos EUA contra taxação
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for his actions in the U.S., where he advocated during a USTR public hearing that Brazil should not be taxed by the Donald Trump administration. Caiado deemed the stance inappropriate and potentially harmful to national interests.

item.title: Lula colhe mandioca “sem agrotóxico” e “sem tarifaço”, posta Janja
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva harvested on Sunday, July 5, 2026, a new cassava variety developed by Embrapa, emphasizing it is free of agrotoxins and tariffs. First Lady Janja da Silva shared the video on her Instagram on Wednesday, July 8, describing the cassava as '100% Brazilian and 200% delicious'. Lula joked that after Ana Maria Braga tastes it, she will recognize its flavor, and noted productivity could reach 60 tons per hectare.

item.title: Grupo ‘INSS com Lula’ no WhatsApp desaba, e impacto político pode ser o oposto do pretendido
item.description: The WhatsApp group 'INSS with Lula', created by institute staff to support Lula's campaign, was shut down after a VEJA report revealed it was managed by superiors and used indirect pressure on employees to participate. The initiative was criticized for violating public administration impartiality rules during the pre-electoral period, posing risks of institutional politicization and causing discomfort among staff without political affinity to the government.

item.title: As intenções de voto de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em São Paulo, segundo o Datafolha
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied at 35% voting intention in the first round in São Paulo, according to Datafolha. In a simulated second-round scenario, Bolsonaro leads technically with 46% versus Lula's 43%, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: PT diz que finaliza obras na Bahia, mas ACM Neto coloca entregas em dúvida
item.description: ACM Neto, pre-candidate for governor of Bahia, criticizes President Lula and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues for claiming to deliver projects like the Salvador-Itaparica Bridge and the Ilhéus-Itabuna duplication, asserting these are mere social media stunts without real completion. He accuses the government of repeating empty promises in electoral cycles, stating that Bahian voters are not fooled by such tactics.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em SP; petista tem rejeição maior
item.description: In São Paulo, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied at 35% in first-round voting intentions, according to a Datafolha poll. Lula has higher rejection (51%) compared to Flávio Bolsonaro (43%). In a potential runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro leads technically with 46% versus 43% for Lula, within the margin of error.

item.title: Novo formalizará candidatura de Zema ao Planalto em 27 de julho
item.description: The Novo party will formalize Romeu Zema's pre-candidacy for the Presidency of the Republic on July 27, during a convention in Brasília. The former governor of Minas Gerais has not yet chosen his running mate, though he mentioned businessman Geraldo Rufino (Podemos) as one of the potential candidates for the ticket.

item.title: Zema defende mudança no STF, critica Gilmar e cita Vorcaro
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo), a 2026 presidential pre-candidate, advocated for STF reforms during the CNC’s Agenda dos Presidenciáveis in Brasília, criticizing Justice Gilmar Mendes by claiming he 'flew on the banker criminal’s jet' and that the Court is 'full of rotten fruit'. Zema proposed reforms such as a minimum age of 60 for justices and pre-approved lists to limit presidential influence, condemned monocratic rulings, and emphasized a 'moral and ethical shock', alongside cuts in federal spending and public security as his top three priorities if elected.

item.title: Michelle é mulher mais poderosa do país para 15% dos brasileiros
item.description: A Meio/Ideia poll shows 15.4% of Brazilians view Michelle Bolsonaro as the country’s most powerful woman, followed by Janja da Silva (9%), Cármen Lúcia (4.5%), and Dilma Rousseff (2.5%). Conducted July 3–6, 2026 among 1,500 respondents, the survey came after Michelle posted videos claiming she was humiliated by her stepson, Flávio Bolsonaro. Margin of error is ±2.5 percentage points at 95% confidence.

item.title: ‘Inaceitável’: a crítica de Caiado a Flávio Bolsonaro por sugerir aos EUA adiamento do tarifaço
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado called it 'unacceptable' that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged the U.S. to delay the tariff increase until after Brazil's elections, arguing the issue should serve national interests, not electoral strategy. Caiado stated the move would politically benefit President Lula and claimed voting for Flávio Bolsonaro would effectively re-elect the PT leader.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mostra principal desafio de Flávio contra Lula e o ‘teto’ do petista na disputa
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows Lula with 40.4% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 32% in the first round, maintaining a difference within the margin of error. The third way continues to fail to gain traction, with candidates like Caiado, Zema and Aécio below 5%. In the second round, Lula leads with 45% against Flávio's 40%, indicating a plateau in the race.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em SP para presidente, mas petista tem rejeição maior
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied in voting intentions in São Paulo for the 2026 presidential race, in both first and second round scenarios. However, Lula has higher rejection rates among São Paulo voters.

item.title: Zema ataca STF, 'gastança' de Lula e relação de autoridades com Vorcaro: 'Brasil precisa de quem não tem rabo preso'
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential pre-candidate, criticized the Supreme Federal Court (STF) as having 'rotten fruits,' advocated for reforms such as a minimum age of 60 for justices and ending individual magistrate rulings, and claimed Brazil needs representatives without 'ties,' alluding to alleged links between officials and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. He also denounced Lula's 'spending spree,' pledging three management shocks: moral and ethical, public security, and cutting public spending to lower interest rates, while proposing to reform Bolsa Família by excluding those who neglect dependents or refuse three formal job offers.

item.title: Em outubro, eleitores escolherão 54 senadores, dois terços da Casa
item.description: In the October 2026 elections, Brazilians will elect 54 senators, representing two-thirds of the 81 seats in the Federal Senate. Each voter will cast ballots for two candidates per state and the Federal District, with the top two vote-getters elected in each jurisdiction without a runoff. Senators serve eight-year terms with staggered elections, and the Senate acts as a reviewing chamber for legislation passed by the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: O estado de alerta no Ministério da Fazenda após novos ataques entre EUA e Irã
item.description: Brazil's Finance Ministry has entered a state of alert due to the escalation of the conflict between the U.S. and Iran, which has driven up oil prices and threatens to reverse the withdrawal of fuel subsidies. Minister Dario Durigan stated that the removal of remaining subsidies will be adjusted in tandem with the war's situation, stressing the need to monitor its impact on Brazilians. Oil prices rose from around $70 to nearly $80 per barrel following Trump's remarks that the ceasefire had ended.

item.title: Caciques do PP admitem constrangimento por Canella e dizem que decisão cabe ao União
item.description: PP leaders admitted discomfort over the Federal Police operation that arrested former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella, a Senate pre-candidate, on suspicion of involvement in a money laundering scheme and illegal possession of a restricted firearm. Despite the seriousness of the situation, they stated that the decision regarding a potential backup plan for the ticket headed by Douglas Ruas lies with União Brasil, Canella’s party through the federation with the PP. Leaders acknowledged they have little moral authority to intervene, noting that PP national president Ciro Nogueira was also previously targeted by PF operations, though he was not arrested.

item.title: Caiado critica proposta de Flávio Bolsonaro para adiar tarifa dos EUA
item.description: Pre-presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) proposal to delay the implementation of new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products until after the 2026 elections. Caiado called the suggestion a mistake in managing Brazil-U.S. trade relations, arguing it undermines serious negotiations and harms Brazil's international image.

item.title: Comissão da Câmara convoca Mauro Vieira para explicar risco de ação militar dos EUA no Brasil
item.description: The Chamber's Foreign Relations Committee approved the convocation of Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira to explain the Brazilian government's stance following the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. The request was made by Deputy Evair de Melo (PP-ES), who deems the Itamaraty's response inadequate. While the ministry warned of a potential risk of U.S. military force, lawmakers like Arlindo Chinaglia (PT-SP) reject this interpretation, stating the designation does not authorize military intervention in Brazil.

item.title: PF faz busca por armas na casa onde Bolsonaro cumpre prisão domiciliar
item.description: The Federal Police conducted a search for weapons at the residence where former President Jair Bolsonaro is serving house arrest, ordered by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, but found no firearms. The operation took place on Wednesday, April 8, and was based on suspicions of illegal gun possession. No arrests or citations were made during the action.

item.title: TSE mantém Alex Manente na presidência do Cidadania
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) granted an injunction to keep Alex Manente as president of the Cidadania party, overturning a decision by the TJDFT that had removed him. The TSE ruling emphasized the proximity of party conventions (July 20) and the lack of jurisdiction of the TJDFT over electoral matters, aiming to preserve institutional stability within the party and its federation with the PSDB.

item.title: Apoio do PSDB deve ser precedido de manifestação de interesse de Tarcísio, diz Aécio
item.description: PSDB leader Aécio Neves stated that the party's support for Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election in São Paulo will depend on an explicit expression of interest from the governor, emphasizing that the initiative must come from him. He also said he respects Paulo Serra's decision to withdraw from the gubernatorial race to run for Congress, though he believes Serra still wants to back Tarcísio. Aécio ruled out any PSDB support for the PT in São Paulo and noted a meeting this week will determine the party's stance.

item.title: Aécio descarta candidatura do PSDB à Presidência e vê eleição ‘fratricida’ entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: Aécio Neves, national president of the PSDB, ruled out a presidential candidacy for the party in 2026, describing the election as marked by the 'trap of political radicalization' and potentially 'the most fratricidal in recent Brazilian history'. He criticized both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating the PSDB will not support either in the runoff, and advocated for a centrist project to overcome polarization, emphasizing that Brazil is 'much bigger than Lula and bolsonarism combined'.

item.title: Glossário Eleitoral explica o que é a mesa receptora de votos
item.description: The vote receiving board (MRV) is the group of electors summoned by the Electoral Justice to operate in each electoral section during elections, composed of a president, first and second poll workers, two secretaries, and a substitute. Serving as a poll worker is a way to contribute to Brazilian democracy by guiding citizens on correct voting participation. The Electoral Justice has begun naming poll workers for the 2026 elections, with deadlines until August 5 for general appointments and until August 28 for specific roles such as logistical support and transit voting.

item.title: O que causou constrangimento durante passagem de Flávio Bolsonaro nos EUA, segundo economista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a U.S. Trade Office hearing caused discomfort due to prohibited cellphone use and a politically biased speech lacking technical substance, according to economist Gustavo Pessoa.

item.title: Fachin afirma que Brasil é soberano e não crê em ação americana no país após classificação de CV e PCC como grupos terroristas
item.description: Supreme Court President Luiz Edson Fachin stated that Brazil is sovereign and does not believe in American intervention, despite the U.S. designation of CV and PCC as terrorist groups. He clarified that the creation of three specialized courts in São Paulo for money laundering and organized crime was the result of prior planning, not a reaction to the U.S. decision. Fachin also voiced concern about organized crime infiltrating elections and affirmed support for the Electoral Court to ensure a free and sovereign vote.

item.title: Flávio: busca por armas na casa de Bolsonaro foi "constrangedora"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro condemned the search and seizure at former President Jair Bolsonaro's residence as embarrassing and overly thorough, stating that the defense had already disclosed the locations of all legally registered firearms linked to his father and that the operation was a distraction while he advocated for Brazil's trade interests in the U.S. He emphasized that no weapons were found in the home and accused Justice Alexandre de Moraes of bad faith, claiming the family is enduring relentless persecution.

item.title: Operação Unha e Carne: preso com fuzil em operação da PF, Márcio Canella, pré-candidato ao Senado, passa a noite em presídio no Rio
item.description: Belford Roxo's former mayor and União Brasil Senate pre-candidate Márcio Canella was arrested in flagrante after federal police found a rifle in his suitcase during Operation Unha e Carne, which investigates money laundering via gas stations. He spent the night at José Frederico Marques Prison awaiting a custody hearing to determine if his detention will be upheld or if he will be released to answer charges. The operation, authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, included searches at 19 addresses and has so far seized 11 luxury vehicles, around R$800,000 in cash, luxury watches and other firearms.

item.title: Tarifaço de Trump: Caiado chama de 'inaceitável' pedido de Flávio para adiamento e diz que governo Lula deve deixar ideologia 'de lado'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's request to delay the U.S. tariff increase, calling it 'unacceptable' and urging the Lula government to set aside ideology in negotiations with Trump. He also stated that voting for Flávio Bolsonaro would help reelect Lula in a potential runoff, given the senator's high rejection rates.

item.title: Boulos diz que eleição de 2026 será “Lula contra Trump”
item.description: Guilherme Boulos, minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, claims the 2026 Brazilian presidential election will not be Lula versus Flávio Bolsonaro, but Lula versus Donald Trump, arguing the U.S. president seeks to intervene in Brazil’s vote to secure access to its rare earth minerals. He states Trump views Brazil as a 'stone in his shoe' due to its potential to lead an independent, sovereign project in Latin America, while Flávio Bolsonaro would represent a Brazil submissive to U.S. interests.

item.title: Proposta de Flávio de adiar tarifaço para depois das eleições é inaceitável, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor and 2026 presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) called the proposal by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to delay tariff increases until after the presidential elections unacceptable. Caiado argued that economic measures should not be manipulated for electoral gain.
